Both Assistant A and Assistant B provided relevant and insightful responses to the user's question about how the stages of life shape our understanding of time and mortality. However, when asked to write an allegorical poem illustrating the concept, Assistant B's poem was more detailed and better captured the essence of the stages of life and their impact on our understanding of time and mortality. Assistant B's poem also had a more consistent allegorical structure, making it a stronger representation of the user's request. Therefore, I would choose Assistant B as the better assistant in this case.
